event_media_object_deletions_terminal_sh.name: event_media_object_deletions_terminal_shape
event_media_object_deletions_terminal_sh.value: ("event_media_object_deletions"."status" = 'pending' AND "event_media_object_deletions"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "event_media_object_deletions"."failed_at" IS NULL) OR ("event_media_object_deletions"."status" = 'deleted' AND "event_media_object_deletions"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "event_media_object_deletions"."failed_at" IS NULL) OR ("event_media_object_deletions"."status" = 'failed' AND "event_media_object_deletions"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "event_media_object_deletions"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL)

event_media_uploads_terminal_shape.name: event_media_uploads_terminal_shape
event_media_uploads_terminal_shape.value: ("event_media_uploads"."status" = 'attached' AND "event_media_uploads"."attached_event_version" IS NOT NULL AND "event_media_uploads"."failure_code" IS NULL) OR ("event_media_uploads"."status" = 'pending' AND "event_media_uploads"."attached_event_version" IS NULL AND "event_media_uploads"."failure_code" IS NULL) OR ("event_media_uploads"."status" IN ('rejected', 'conflict', 'expired') AND "event_media_uploads"."attached_event_version" IS NULL AND "event_media_uploads"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL)

event_media_uploads_object_deletion_shap.name: event_media_uploads_object_deletion_shape
event_media_uploads_object_deletion_shap.value: NOT ("event_media_uploads"."object_deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "event_media_uploads"."object_deletion_failed_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("event_media_uploads"."status" IN ('rejected', 'conflict', 'expired') OR ("event_media_uploads"."object_deletion_attempt_count" = 0 AND "event_media_uploads"."object_deleted_at" IS NULL AND "event_media_uploads"."object_deletion_failed_at" IS NULL))

event_ticket_types_description_shape.name: event_ticket_types_description_shape
event_ticket_types_description_shape.value: "event_ticket_types"."description" IS NULL OR ("event_ticket_types"."description" = btrim("event_ticket_types"."description") AND char_length("event_ticket_types"."description") BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

event_venues_region_length.name: event_venues_region_length
event_venues_region_length.value: "event_venues"."region" IS NULL OR char_length("event_venues"."region") BETWEEN 1 AND 120

event_venues_postal_code_length.name: event_venues_postal_code_length
event_venues_postal_code_length.value: "event_venues"."postal_code" IS NULL OR char_length("event_venues"."postal_code") BETWEEN 1 AND 32

event_venues_region_code.name: event_venues_region_code
event_venues_region_code.value: "event_venues"."region_code" IS NULL OR ("event_venues"."region" IS NOT NULL AND "event_venues"."region_code" ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]{0,7}$')

events_description_length.name: events_description_length
events_description_length.value: "events"."description" IS NULL OR char_length("events"."description") BETWEEN 1 AND 10000

events_schedule_valid.name: events_schedule_valid
events_schedule_valid.value: ("events"."starts_at" IS NULL AND "events"."ends_at" IS NULL AND "events"."time_zone" IS NULL) OR ("events"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."ends_at" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."time_zone" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."ends_at" > "events"."starts_at")

events_details_complete.name: events_details_complete
events_details_complete.value: ("events"."description" IS NULL AND "events"."starts_at" IS NULL AND "events"."ends_at" IS NULL AND "events"."time_zone" IS NULL) OR ("events"."description" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."ends_at" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."time_zone" IS NOT NULL)

events_time_zone_length.name: events_time_zone_length
events_time_zone_length.value: "events"."time_zone" IS NULL OR char_length("events"."time_zone") BETWEEN 1 AND 64
